🎮 Core Features

ElysianArenaBE is a multi-minigame server project based on Minecraft Bedrock Edition, utilizing modern proxy architecture and highly optimized server cores. We are committed to providing players with a smooth, stable, and creative gaming experience. The server features a complete game ecosystem and an active player community, making it one of the outstanding representatives of Bedrock Edition minigame servers in China.

1. Ultimate Performance Optimization

We employ the latest WaterdogPE proxy architecture combined with multi-node load balancing technology to ensure smooth gameplay even with hundreds of players online simultaneously. The server is equipped with professional-grade hardware and high-speed network connections, maintaining an average latency below 100ms for zero-lag gaming.

2. Diverse Game Modes

The server focuses on various carefully designed minigames, each polished over months with unique gameplay and balance adjustments:

Duel: Players can challenge others to one-on-one battles in dedicated arenas at any time. Supports multiple weapon combinations and combat strategies, testing players' operational skills and tactical thinking.

Elysian World: An open-world survival continent where players can freely explore, build, trade, and form teams. The map includes rich biomes, hidden treasures, and challenge quests, supporting players in establishing their own towns and factions.

SkyWars: Classic sky island battle mode where players spawn on isolated islands floating in the void. They must quickly gather resources, build paths, and defeat all opponents. Fast-paced gameplay emphasizes strategy, building, and PVP.
